g.text: Consistent Hashing: only a slice moves when a server joins
Same ring, before and after Server E joins between B and C
Naive hash % N: adding a 5th server reshuffles ~80% of ALL keys
(every key's owner depends on N, which just changed).
Consistent hashing: E only steals the slice (4000, 6000] from C.
A, B, D keep every key they owned before -- untouched.
